tips.text: Join an established clan whose Bio Lab chain is finished; building a solo dojo just for this weapon is a long ordeal.
Check the Bio Lab console first; most established clans finished the Mutagen Mass to Bubonico research years ago.
In a solo or small clan, do not build a higher barracks tier; the clan tier multiplies every research cost.
Budget 100 Mutagen Samples for the ten Mutagen Mass; the build needs them on top of the 35 the research uses.
Farm the 3 Argon Crystals last and press Build the same day; the pile halves at the second reset.
Do not buy the Coda Bubonico; it is a separate weapon and does not substitute.
With a finished Bio Lab it is a one-evening farm; the complaints are about the Bio Lab and the Sample grind.
